notes: Component 'Create' in 'Set MF on employers' performs an UPDATE of gen_employers (RequestType.Update, Entity.Id set), not a create.

Only rows that pass 'Check If Date Valid' are written, but then ALL five non-NULL values are sent: a row with a valid deposit start date writes the accumulation amount/dates even when the accumulation period is expired or not yet started, and vice versa.

gen_mfaccumulation comes from 'גמל' for pension-fund employer records (ProductTypeCode 200001/1) and from 'השתלמות' for study-fund records (200000/2); records with any other product type are dropped (unconnected 'DE Output'). The same file row updates every gen_employers record with that corporate number.

The corporate number 'ח פ' is only trimmed (no zero padding) and must equal gen_employers.gen_corporatenumber exactly (Merge Join, case/space-sensitive sort compare). 'שם מעסיק' is read but never reaches CRM.
Every cast error in 'convert' (bad date/number text) and every source parse error has errorRowDisposition=FailComponent → the data flow fails rather than skipping the row.
Create's ExcecuteBulk ignores a null/empty ExecuteMultiple response (no exception, main.cs:149-169); faults are routed to the Error output → ETL warning only.

'Update employer amount' (direct SQL on AccountBase, Unsupported) does not use the file at all: it recomputes, for every account, the sum of gen_fundmain.gen_accountbalance of its employers' funds and the balance-weighted management fee. Funds whose Gen_managementFeePercentage is NULL drop out of the numerator (NULL product ignored by SUM) but still count in the denominator, lowering the weighted fee. modifiedon/modifiedby are not touched (bypasses CRM auditing/plugins).
Out of scope (ETL plumbing): Create/End/Error ETL Process record, ETL Warning 1 (+ Set Warning columns*), Get Variables From SystemConfigurarion, Check File Existence, Move FileTo Archive.
